turns.assessment: The evidence localizes the initiating fault to inline amplifier oms.S24-S18.amp2. It raised AMP_GAIN_OOR at t=602.5 and then showed a roughly 3.25 dB output-power drop while its input power and pump current showed no change; the same loss propagated into amp3, amp4, and every monitored channel at S18. This is the documented signature of an amplifier gain drop and is much stronger than a span or transmitter hypothesis. The resulting optical degradation increased BER on affected lightpaths and ultimately drove svc352 onto protection.

proposals.rationale: AMP_GAIN_OOR was followed by a 3.25 dB fall in this amplifier's output with unchanged input and pump current. Downstream amplifier inputs/outputs and all S18 OCM channels show the same loss, directly localizing the loss generation to amp2.
Added loss between amp2 and amp3 could lower amp3 input, but it does not explain the measured output-power reduction and gain alarm at amp2 itself.
